# Release Notes: March 31, 2026 

The Network360 Team is excited to share the latest updates designed to enhance your experience. 

## New Features 

### Added Auto-Match Configuration for Disruption Analysis 

Added an **Auto-match** option in the Disruption **Create Analysis** workflow that automatically runs all valid matching passes on each row of the utilization file.  

When Auto-match is enabled, manual matching configuration is disabled, partial matches are assigned default values, and matched data is stored row-by-row.  

Users are informed using an informational message that the comprehensive review using the Auto-Match may take longer, and progress can be tracked via the existing **My Analysis** progress bar. They can cancel or rerun an analysis from the **My Analysis** table using existing controls. 



## Fixes 

### Tooltip Positioning Fixed in Summary Overview Chart 

Adjusted tooltip positioning in the Summary Overview chart so that hover tooltips no longer overlap or obstruct network labels or the Y - axis, ensuring consistent, readable display of both tooltips and network names across all bar lengths.
